item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, json, math, work\\nP={'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01},'unique':True}\\ncases=[\\n({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':2}]},{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':2}],'errors':[]}),\\n({'rows':[{'id':'','amount':-1,'unit':'x'},{'id':'a','amount':True},{'id':'b','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'c','amount':1,'unit':'x'}]},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'amount'},{'row':3,'cause':'unit'}]}),\\n({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':-1},{'id':'a','amount':1},{'id':'a','amount':2}]},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'duplicate'}]}),\\n({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':3,'unit':'cm'}]},{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':0.03}],'errors':[]}),\\n]\\nfor req, expected in cases:\\n before=copy.deepcopy(req); got=work.evaluate(req,P); assert got==expected,(got,expected); assert req==before\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert report==[work.evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]\\nfor result in report:\\n assert set(result)=={'ok','records','errors'}\\n for record in result['records']: assert set(record)=={'id','amount'}\\n for error in result['errors']: assert set(error)=={'row','cause'}\\nprint('all validation and report checks passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"status\",\"--short\"]}}]}"}
